hook.name: SUBAHook
hook.description: Implements a sealed-bid uniform-price batch auction over Uniswap v4 pools. Incoming exact-input swaps are buffered per epoch via ERC-6909 minting in beforeSwap (suppressing AMM execution); a permissioned keeper settles each epoch at a single uniform clearing price, matching buy and sell volume proportionally and distributing outputs to per-order user addresses.
